title: James Pond - Codename RoboCod
sources: own knowledge of the game (facts written for this def)
notes: Genre: Platformer. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text: A jump, R/up stretch: RoboCod extends his body upward to grab ceilings.
widgets.label: Controls

widgets.text: Stretch up to climb; jump on enemies to defeat them.
widgets.label: Abilities

widgets.text: Stretch to reach high platforms and avoid boss attacks.
widgets.label: Tips

widgets.text: Santa's toy factory: doors lead to themed worlds of levels.
widgets.label: Structure

widgets.text: Cakes, toys and bonus items; vehicles (car, plane, bathtub) in some levels.
widgets.label: Items

widgets.text: Rescue the penguins in each level to open the exit.
widgets.label: Collect

widgets.text: Clear all worlds and defeat Dr. Maybe.
widgets.label: Goal
